business_problem: To further support customers, JATO Dynamics wanted to create a reporting tool to offer car dealerships insights into their own performance compared to the market, including metrics like sales price, discount rates, and feature popularity.
solution_summary: JATO Dynamics built this solution on Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Data Factory, Azure App Service. To further support customers, JATO Dynamics wanted to create a reporting tool to offer car dealerships insights into their own performance compared to the market, including metrics like sales price, discount rates, and feature popularity. Azure OpenAI Service provides the generative AI model layer used for summarization, drafting, classification, or copilots in the workflow. Azure AI Search indexes enterprise content so assistants and applications can retrieve grounded answers. Azure Data Factory moves and orchestrates data from source systems into the analytics platform. Azure App Service hosts the web application and API endpoints for the solution. JATO used the full Microsoft Azure stack, especially Azure OpenAI Service, to develop Sales Link. JATO Dynamics chose to use Microsoft Azure AI , specifically Azure OpenAI Service , to develop Sales Link.
